text.description_html:
Fusion TR-B2, Round Radius Rose Hand Towel Ring

The Traditional Round Mount Wall Mounted Towel Ring is easy to install with the included hardware pack. Mount one on the wall near the sink both in the bathroom and also in the kitchen. It is great for keeping those hand towels off of the counter where they can dry. The radius rose mount has a classic silhouette that makes it a stunning addition to traditional homes. Choose from antique pewter, antique copper, or oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-B2 Traditional Round Mount Towel Bar, Fusion PH-B2 Traditional Round Mount Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion RH-B2 Traditional Round Mount Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Radius Mount Towel Ring:

  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
